summary: Case ho-06 (f.yildiz@aegean.edu) is assessed benign (confidence 0.85); no compromise signal survived Critic review. F1: Claimed bulk SIS access from 193.140.10.21 was rejected after a recount returned 461 events versus 100 claimed. F2: Alleged password spray followed by user sign-in was rejected because 193.140.10.21 is shared egress with 202 distinct MFA accounts in 30 days, making failures background noise.

risk.rationale: No surviving verified findings exist for ho-06. Both suspicious claims were rejected and explained away: (1) the claimed 100 SIS successes from 193.140.10.21 failed independent recount (461 events, outside the 10% tolerance), so the bulk-access claim is not supported; (2) the password-spray-then-success claim is refuted because 193.140.10.21 is shared egress with 202 distinct accounts completing MFA from it in 30 days (threshold 10), making cross-account failures expected background noise rather than a coordinated spray. With no confirmed account-takeover chain and no confirmed finding to override the obvious call, the signals are explained as benign.
